summary.pack_description:
Get ready to jump back into the history books of the NHL and relive the debuts of today’s perennial all-stars, ascending franchise cornerstones, and future legends! Introducing Opening Ice: Elites, an exhilarating set that captures the unforgettable moments when the game's current stars scored their first career NHL goal or debut victory. 

Featuring the first NHL goals and wins from some of the biggest names in the League like Sidney Crosby, Cale Makar, Kirill Kaprizov, Anze Kopitar, Elias Pettersson, Igor Shesterkin and more!

Each pack contains 1 Opening Ice: Elites highlight, 3 Base highlights, plus 1 mystery highlight that could be from Making the Mark, Opening Ice, or Base sets.
summary.pack_title: Opening Ice: Elites Debut LE Pack

release.name: Opening Ice: Elites Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Tuesday, Oct 10 at 1PM ET / 10AM PT

Eligibility: Beta users only. Not a beta user? Click here to create your account.

 

Price: $65 USD

# Packs Available: 2000 packs total

 

Purchase Limit: Six (6) pack limit per person. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 5

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • One (1) Opening Ice: Elites highlight (Rare #/250)
  • Three (3) 2022-23 Base highlights (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 72% 2022-23 Base highlight (Core)
    • 22% Opening Ice highlight (Rare)
    • 6% Making the Mark highlight (Epic)

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe. Purchases via cryptocurrency and ACH transfers into your NHL Breakaway account are coming later in 2023.

 

Set Completion: Opening Ice: Elites will be added to Set Completion later in Series 1.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights will be eligible to be sold to other collectors on the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace later in 2023.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights will be eligible to be traded with other NHL Breakaway users later in 2023.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Full Highlights List
  • Opening Ice: Elites, Series 1 - Preview
  • Base, Series 1 - Preview (Expansion) | Preview (Original)
  • Opening Ice, Series 1 - Preview
  • Making the Mark, Series 1 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 1 highlights will only be distributed during Series 1, which ends ~September 2024. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

pack_series.name: Series 1
pack_series.description: Series 1 is the inaugural series of the NHL Breakaway program featuring highlights and collectibles from the 2022-23 and 2023-24 season, and curated plays from the archives that are known as some of the greatest achievements in NHL history.

summary.name: Opening Ice: Elites
summary.description: Introducing Opening Ice: Elites, an exhilarating set that captures the unforgettable moments when the game's current stars scored their first career NHL goal or a talented goalie secured his debut NHL victory. This exclusive collection showcases the raw talent and emotion of these rising stars as they etch their names in NHL history. Experience the sheer joy and determination as they find the back of the net or defend their crease in their milestone moments. Opening Ice: Elites is a celebration of the sport's future legends and a must-have addition to any hockey enthusiast's collection, cherishing the beginnings of remarkable careers.

summary.description: The Series 1 Base set is a collection of meaningful highlights from each team in the League that occurred during the 2022-23 season.

summary.description: Making the Mark set celebrates record-setting and career accomplishments of the recent season – moments that have the opportunity to transcend the game and become landmarks in the annals of NHL history.
